title: 7.11. Sekkhattika
note: Pāli only: every English translation of the Abhidhamma is still under copyright, so no English can be shown yet. A free translation will be added if one becomes available.

verses.t: Nasekkhaṁ dhammaṁ paṭicca …pe… naasekkhaṁ dhammaṁ paṭicca …pe… nanevasekkhanāsekkhaṁ dhammaṁ paṭicca …. (Saṅkhittaṁ.)
Hetuyā ekūnatiṁsa, ārammaṇe catuvīsa …pe… āsevane sattarasa …pe… avigate ekūnatiṁsa.
